title: 第15章 圣女安好，勿动，静候
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
街边的茶摊，热气腾腾。

    陈然要了一碗大碗茶，两文钱，茶叶沫子浮在水面上，苦涩，但解渴。

    他压低了斗笠，缩在角落，像个刚进城的落魄汉子。

    邻桌坐着两个佩刀的江湖客，唾沫横飞。

    “听说了吗？黑风寨的雷老虎折了。”

    “早知道了。听说昨晚被六扇门的林琬林捕头像拖死狗一样拖回来的。”

    “这雷老虎也是倒霉。我听六扇门的兄弟说，林捕头昨晚本来是去追人，结果半道上撞见雷老虎在劫道，顺手就给收拾了。”

    “顺手？那可是七品巅峰的高手！”

    “嘿，在林家大小姐面前，七品算个屁。听说只用了三剑，雷老虎就被挑断了手筋脚筋。”

    陈然端着茶碗的手微微一顿。

    原来如此。

    昨晚天牢暴动，林琬看来是没有追到。

    这雷老虎，确实够倒霉的。

    不过，这也解释了为什么林琬今天杀气那么重。

    追丢了正主，拿个替死鬼撒气。

    陈然喝干了碗里的茶，扔下两枚铜板，起身融入人流。

    ……

    长春客栈。

    位于城南青鱼巷，门面不大，但生意红火。

    老板娘叫柳三娘，是个风韵犹存的半老徐娘，使得一手好泼风刀，在这鱼龙混杂的城南也算号人物。

    此刻，她正倚在柜台上，百无聊赖地嗑着瓜子。

    “当当当。”

    柜台被敲响。

    柳三娘眼皮都没抬：“住店还是打尖？”

    “有人让我给您带句话。”

    声音稚嫩，清脆。

    柳三娘低头。

    柜台前站着个流着鼻涕的小乞丐，手里抓着一串糖葫芦，正眼巴巴地看着她。

    “去去去，哪来的野孩子，别挡着老娘做生意。”

    柳三娘挥了挥手，像赶苍蝇一样。

    小乞丐吸了吸鼻涕，大声说道：

    “那人说：‘一壶老酒温三遍，不要红皮，牛肉切薄透光’。”

    咔嚓。

    柳三娘手里的瓜子壳碎了。

    她猛地直起身子，那双原本慵懒的桃花眼里，瞬间爆射出两道精光，死死盯着小乞丐。

    大堂里的嘈杂声似乎都远去了。

    这是红莲魔教的最高级切口！
content_en:
The tea stalls on the street are steaming hot.

    Chen Ran ordered a large bowl of tea for two cents. Tea foam floated on the water, which was bitter but quenched his thirst.

    He lowered his hat and huddled in the corner, like a down-and-out man who had just entered the city.

    Sitting at the next table were two charlatans armed with swords, saliva flying from ear to ear.

    "Did you hear that? The Thunder Tiger of Black Wind Village was broken."

    "I knew it earlier. I heard that he was dragged back last night by Lin Wan from the Six Doors, like a dog to death."

    "Thunder Tiger is also unlucky. I heard from the brothers at Liumen that Capt. Lin was chasing someone last night, but he bumped into Thunder Tiger trying to rob him on the way, so he took care of him."

    "Smoothly? That's a peak seventh-grade master!"

    "Hey, in front of the eldest lady of the Lin family, the seventh grade is nothing. I heard that Lei Huhu broke his hand and hamstrings with just three swords."

    Chen Ran's hand holding the tea bowl paused slightly.

    I see.

    There was a riot in Tianlao last night, and it seemed that Lin Wan didn't catch up.

    This Thunder Tiger is indeed quite unlucky.

    However, this also explains why Lin Wan is so murderous today.

    If you lose the real owner, take a scapegoat to vent your anger on.

    Chen Ran drank up the tea in the bowl, threw down the two coins, stood up and merged into the crowd.

    …

    Changchun Inn.

    Located in Qingyu Lane in the south of the city, it has a small storefront, but its business is booming.

    The landlady's name is Liu Sanniang. She is a middle-aged lady who still retains her charm. She is good at throwing wind knives, and she is considered a prominent figure in the mixed city south of the city.

    At this moment, she was leaning on the counter, eating melon seeds out of boredom.

    "Dang Dang Dang."

    There was a knock on the counter.

    Liu Sanniang didn't even raise her eyelids: "Stay in a hotel or go to the hospital?"

    "I was asked to bring you a message."

    The voice is young and crisp.

    Liu Sanniang lowered her head.

    Standing in front of the counter was a little beggar with a runny nose, holding a bunch of candied haws in his hand and looking at her eagerly.

    "Go, go, you wild child, don't stop me from doing business."

    Liu Sanniang waved her hand as if to shoo away flies.

    The little beggar sniffed and said loudly:

    "The man said: 'Warm a pot of old wine three times, don't want red skin, cut the beef thinly and translucent'."

    Click.

    The melon seed shell in Liu Sanniang's hand shattered.

    She straightened up suddenly, and her originally lazy peach blossom eyes instantly shot out two rays of light, staring at the little beggar.

    The noise in the lobby seemed to have faded away.

    This is the most advanced incision of the Red Lotus Demon Cult!
title_en: Chapter 15 The saint is well, don’t move, wait quietly
